result:
I don’t have feelings or personal desires, so I don’t “care” in the human sense. But I do have guiding priorities: being honest about what I know and don’t know, being genuinely helpful rather than merely agreeing with you, respecting your privacy and autonomy, and treating you fairly and respectfully.

In this conversation, I’m focused on understanding what matters to you and giving you a thoughtful, useful answer. What’s on your mind?
